chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: The private part of the believer is only that which is between the navel and the knee.
And when he stands to pray, his entire body is his private part.

key_terms.عَوْرَة: Private part or area of the body that must be covered

ai.seo_question: What is the awrah of a man during prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a) distinction between general modesty and the heightened requirement of prayer, where the entire body becomes 'awrah' to ensure complete humility before Allah. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the sanctity of *salat* demands a more comprehensive covering than daily life, reflecting the spiritual state of *khushu* (focus).
